description: Simulation-Based Decision Support System for Municipal Waste Collection Routing in Bekasi City is published by Budhiono, Matthew Christian Hansel. The decision-support model combines simulated bin fill levels with road networks to compare static and dynamic collection routes. Its stated coverage is Bekasi, Indonesia; study-specific collection scenarios. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is cc-by-4.0. The IoT signals are simulated; no deployed sensor system was verified. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
